typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tighter text-[#002D62]
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#0F172A]
typography.label: text-xs font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-[#D90429]
rules: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings.
Use tight tracking on large headings.
Limit H1 size to text-6xl maximum.
Ensure contrast on hover and active states.

spacing_and_layout.scale: Tailwind standard, prioritize generous spacing (p-8, p-12, p-16).
spacing_and_layout.grid_mode: Grid Borders (The Technical Look) for Dashboards/Services; Bento Grid for About section.
spacing_and_layout.hero_overlay: bg-gradient-to-r from-white/90 via-white/70 to-transparent for light mode hero.

surfaces.cards: Flat background (surface), 1px subtle border (border-border), no massive shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow.
surfaces.navigation: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80, 1px bottom border-white/40.
surfaces.dashboard: Sharp edges or subtle roundness (max 8px). Cardless, rectangular, dense styles.

hero.content: L'Excellence Logistique et Douanière. Transport, Transit et Dédouanement.
hero.visuals: React Three Fiber canvas taking up the right side or background. Use Box primitives styled as shipping containers (red, blue, white) floating/animating with parallax, or a 3D truck representation if possible.
hero.cta: Demander un devis (Primary), Découvrir nos services (Secondary)

about.content: Fondée en 2019, GLS est une agence en douane experte. Focus sur la précision et la rapidité.
about.visuals: Mix text cards with imagery of customs professionals scanning boxes.

sectors.visuals: Rich imagery per sector. Hover states reveal details.

partners.content: AECL, SicoMine, Jambo Mart, Malibu Cars.
partners.visuals: Since generic logos lack authenticity, use clean typographic treatments with Lucide icons (e.g., Pickaxe for SicoMine, Car for Malibu Cars) in a slow, elegant marquee.

contact.visuals: Clean Shadcn form. Submissions must be saved to the database.

admin_dashboard.content: Tableau de bord admin pour voir les messages de contact.
admin_dashboard.visuals: Dense, functional UI. No glassmorphism. Solid white/grey with sharp data tables.

hero_background.description: Large cargo ship at a dock (use for parallax backgrounds or sector imagery)

logistics_worker_1.description: Warehouse professional with tablet (use for About section)

logistics_worker_2.description: Worker scanning/ladder (use for About or Services section)

port_cranes.description: Cargo ship with cranes (use for Hero fallback or Parallax section)

technical_instructions.files: Use .js and .jsx extensions exclusively. Do not use .tsx or .ts.
technical_instructions.styling: Tailwind CSS + raw HTML structural elements for creative layouts. Use Shadcn exclusively for complex interactive components (forms, dialogs, dropdowns).
technical_instructions.animations: Framer Motion for scroll reveals, micro-interactions, and layout transitions.
technical_instructions.3d_implementation: Use @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei. Create a component `ShippingContainers3D.jsx`. Use `Box` geometries scaled like containers (e.g., args={[2, 1, 1]}). Apply standard materials in brand colors (#002D62, #FFFFFF, #D90429). Add `Environment` and `Float` from Drei to make them look premium and animated.
technical_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST have role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button').
technical_instructions.scroll: Install and configure @studio-freight/lenis for smooth scrolling.
technical_instructions.database: Setup a simple local storage or sqlite via Node backend (or simulated via an API route in Vite if purely frontend context, but user asks for messages saved to database. Implement a basic Express API or mock standard REST calls in the frontend if backend not explicitly provided, but ensure the admin dashboard consumes this data).
